hypotheses.statement: On held-out problems, the subject's committed predictions of answer flips (Y1) have a higher expected log score than the best equal-information observer O*, chosen on the calibration split from {O1, third person, transcript-only}.
The subject beats the constant base rate O0 (skill > 0).
First-person predictions beat the same model under third-person framing (self-reference specificity).

evidence.title: Self-prediction of ablation effects vs best observer O* (O1_outsider_cells)
evidence.statement: On 80 held-out predictions (40 problems), subject log score -1.391005 bits vs O* = O1_outsider_cells -0.412587; paired difference -0.978418 [-1.375239, -0.575184], sign-flip p = 0.99990001. Decision: rule outcome 'contradicted' capped: the debug_pilot split is diagnostic only. Insensitivity guard (O1 vs O0 CI includes 0): False.
